description:
Get Google Discover summary metrics (clicks, impressions, CTR) for a property, with period-over-period comparison against the equal-length window immediately before the range. Discover is a distinct Search Console surface (the Google Discover feed) — separate from Search performance; use get_gsc_summary for Search. Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d). Returns each metric as *_current / *_prev / *_delta / *_change_pct (ctr is a 0-1 fraction, not a percentage). Discover has no query/position or country/device breakdown, so none is returned. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Discover summary over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_28_days"}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.

name: get_discover_summary
